subject.title: [Feature] Prune stale orphaned sessions from Dashboard Sessions

question: Should Dashboard own explicit orphan-session pruning for Telegram/Discord sessions, and what reachability, default-age, retention, and auto-prune policy should apply?
rationale: Deleting persistent session rows based on external channel reachability is a destructive cross-channel policy choice that current cleanup intentionally does not make.

options.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
options.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, then revalidate and delete only after explicit user confirmation.

options.title: Discord-only cleanup first
options.body: Resolve the narrower Discord thread/channel orphan case in #50310 before generalizing a cross-channel Dashboard workflow.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup only
options.body: Keep selected-row delete/archive and generic session cleanup as the supported paths and decline automatic orphan pruning for now.

recommendation.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
recommendation.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, then revalidate and delete only after explicit user confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans current Dashboard sessions UX, gateway session controls, and product boundary policy where recent current-main history points most strongly to steipete.
